summary: Customer runs a cell culture process in an aqueous medium; glucose and lactate are measured offline from samples, and the delay makes it hard to see changes promptly. They are exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot to be checked against the existing laboratory measurements. The medium and cell population change during the run; no probe or calibration strategy has been selected.
